# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old when introduced, about 15 years old by the end of volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c29 P4](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is described as an extremely attractive girl with rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and dark hair. She is plumper than her friend Nell and has charming dimples when she laughs. She occasionally wishes she were more slender, believing it to be more elegant.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, open-hearted, and quick to laugh. She has a pragmatic mindset, though she readily participates in imaginative games and vows of friendship. She is deeply loyal to her friends and values academic and social achievements.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001)_

## Traits

- Cheerful and open-hearted  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- Crochet and handiwork  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a loyal bosom friend to Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

## History

Isolde grows up at Pear Hill in Brierley and becomes the bosom friend of Nell Harcourt shortly after Nell's arrival at Grey Shutters. The two girls swear an oath of lifelong loyalty over a imaginary stream in the Pembroke garden and establish a playhouse called Larkrise. When Isolde accidentally consumes homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial at Grey Shutters and returns home unwell, her mother forbids her from playing with Nell, leading to a tearful temporary farewell between the friends. After Nell helps care for Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay during an attack of croup, Mrs. Pembroke forgives Nell and allows the girls to resume their friendship. Isolde attends Brierley school alongside Nell, participating in school plays, concerts, the story club, and the Brierley Village Improvement Society. Later, she supports Nell through her academic pursuits and entrance examinations at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P24](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0024), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Raised on Pear Hill in Brierley as the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Pembroke  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- Has a strict mother and a father who encourages her reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- Has a wealthy great-aunt named Lavinia Pembroke living in Port Marlow  <sub>[v1 c19 P53](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0053), [v1 c19 P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060)</sub>
